materialConvention.runtimeMutation: Finite cached demonstration material variants; no mutation of shared neutral bases and no per-frame material allocation.

A01.method: Reopen source and independently import each of 11 FBX files; export contains MESH/EMPTY hierarchy only.

A02.method: Separate source, raw FBX and Unity measurements; 36 raycasts per crate; source contact anchors and Unity N/E axes.

A03.method: Triangle/AABB SAT against actual asset triangles, both orthogonal swept corridors for each crate and measured robot envelope; 3 mm overlay tolerance.

A04.method: Six explicit socket occupancy fixtures; only Energy illuminates independent lamps; visual inspection of covered perimeter.

A05.method: Blue square / purple triangle / lime circle; change only A materials, verify B and fixed body material references unchanged; crate roles have no variable slots.

A06.method: Explicit A=Energy/on, B=Cargo/off fixtures for Any, All and shared A on another gate; independent third badge.
A06.limitation: Presentation fixtures only; formal gameplay integration not performed.

A07.method: 100 source mechanical frames tested; closed/powered-open/unpowered-held fixtures; 72-frame Cargo -> Robot -> empty demo with every source/condition lamp off.
A07.limitation: Presentation fixtures only; formal gameplay integration not performed.

A08.method: Hide all upper wall, gate post/cassette and moving-panel renderers; retain bases and low passage/source markers.

A09.method: Mixed 3x3 floors with quarter turns; whole-cell straight/corner/end, solitary wall, T and cross assemblies.

A10.method: Actual 1920x1080/1280x720 Unity renders, 55-degree FOV at 3.2 m and north-up orthographic views; no postprocessing; grayscale inspection.

A11.method: Relative file paths, full material/path mapping, independent stage statistics, export settings, no image textures/private dependencies, measured-file hash guards.

A12.method: Explicit Energy/Cargo kind mapping, radial energy window design vs closed cargo/X bracing; narrow adjacent/front-back corridor and four-angle grayscale views.

U01.method: 11 imported models, URP/Lit remapping, measured identity roots/coordinates, reusable prefabs, Console inspection.

U02.method: Isolated saved editor showcase, sweep tests, presentation assertions and actual captures; explicit fixture states, not runtime rule events.
U02.limitation: Presentation fixtures only; formal gameplay integration not performed.

limitations: Unity scenes use explicit presentation states, not formal RuleEngine event binding.
Small source badges are intended for elevated/top-down views and may need short UI labels at full-board zoom.
No game-wide regression or performance benchmark is claimed.
